Project Title:
Multilingual News Data Aggregation and Propaganda Pattern Detection using Pandas, spaCy, and Transformers
Reference ID: ai-ml-ds-VxG7PqLmN8z
File Name: multilingual_news_propaganda_detection.py

Short Description

This project focuses on aggregating multilingual news data and detecting propaganda patterns using advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques. Leveraging the capabilities of Pandas for data manipulation, spaCy for linguistic processing, and Transformers for deep learning models, the system aims to identify biased or propagandistic content across various languages. The project utilizes the EUvsDisinfo dataset, which contains multilingual news articles annotated for disinformation, to train and evaluate the models.

Key Learnings

  • Features: Multilingual text processing, Named Entity Recognition (NER), sentiment analysis, propaganda detection.
  • Components: Data ingestion, preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Keywords: NLP, multilingual, propaganda detection, transformers, spaCy, Pandas.
  • Categories: Machine Learning, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing.
  • Research Areas: Multilingual NLP, disinformation detection, transformer models, cross-lingual transfer learning.

Problem Domain

The proliferation of biased and propagandistic news content across different languages poses a significant challenge in the digital age. Detecting such content requires sophisticated NLP techniques capable of understanding context, semantics, and linguistic nuances across languages.

Use Cases

  • Media Monitoring: Automatically identify and flag propagandistic content in news articles across multiple languages.
  • Fact-Checking Organizations: Assist in verifying the credibility of news content.
  • Academic Research: Analyze patterns and trends in propaganda dissemination.
  • Government Agencies: Monitor and counteract foreign disinformation campaigns.

Frameworks Used

  • Pandas: Data manipulation and analysis.
  • spaCy: Linguistic processing and NER.
  • Transformers (Hugging Face): Pretrained transformer models for multilingual text classification.
  • Scikit-learn: Model evaluation metrics.

Development Lifecycle

  1. Requirement Analysis: Define objectives and identify suitable datasets.
  2. Data Collection: Acquire the EUvsDisinfo dataset.
  3. Data Preprocessing: Clean and prepare data for modeling.
  4. Model Selection: Choose appropriate transformer models for multilingual classification.
  5. Model Training: Fine-tune models on the dataset.
  6. Evaluation: Assess model performance using appropriate metrics.
  7. Deployment: Integrate the model into a pipeline for real-time or batch processing.
  8. Monitoring: Continuously monitor model performance and update as necessary.

Sister Projects

  • Multilingual Sentiment Analysis: Analyzing sentiments across different languages.
  • Cross-Lingual Topic Modeling: Identifying topics in multilingual corpora.
  • Fake News Detection: Detecting false information in news articles.

Integration Possibilities

  • News Aggregators: Enhance platforms like Google News with propaganda detection.
  • Social Media Monitoring Tools: Integrate with tools that monitor social media for disinformation.
  • Content Management Systems: Assist editors in identifying biased content.

Project Timeframe

Estimated Completion Time: 8 weeks

Final Product Description

A robust, scalable system capable of ingesting multilingual news articles, processing them to detect propaganda patterns, and providing actionable insights. The system will include a user-friendly interface for analysts to review flagged content and understand the rationale behind classifications.

Advanced Functionalities

  • Cross-Lingual Transfer Learning: Implement models that can transfer knowledge from high-resource languages to low-resource ones.
  • Explainable AI: Provide explanations for model decisions to enhance transparency.
  • Real-Time Processing: Enable real-time detection of propagandistic content as news articles are published.

Future Enhancements

  • Multimodal Analysis: Incorporate images and videos for comprehensive propaganda detection.
  • User Feedback Loop: Allow users to provide feedback to continuously improve model accuracy.
  • Geospatial Analysis: Map the spread of propaganda geographically.

Python Code

# multilingual_news_propaganda_detection.py

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import spacy
from spacy.language import Language
from spacy_langdetect import LanguageDetector
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
from transformers import pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import classification_report
import torch
import os
import logging

# Setup logging
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Constants
MODEL_NAME = "xlm-roberta-base"
DEVICE = 0 if torch.cuda.is_available() else -1

# Load spaCy model with language detection
def get_lang_detector(nlp, name):
    return LanguageDetector()

nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
Language.factory("language_detector", func=get_lang_detector)
nlp.add_pipe('language_detector', last=True)

# Load transformer model and tokenizer
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME, num_labels=2)
classifier = pipeline("text-classification", model=model, tokenizer=tokenizer, device=DEVICE)

# Load dataset
def load_dataset(file_path: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    return df

# Preprocess text
def preprocess_text(text: str) -> str:
    doc = nlp(text)
    return " ".join([token.lemma_ for token in doc if not token.is_stop])

# Detect language
def detect_language(text: str) -> str:
    doc = nlp(text)
    return doc._.language['language']

# Predict propaganda
def predict_propaganda(texts: list) -> list:
    predictions = classifier(texts)
    return [pred['label'] for pred in predictions]

# Evaluate model
def evaluate_model(y_true: list, y_pred: list):
    report = classification_report(y_true, y_pred)
    logger.info("\n" + report)

# Main function
def main():
    # Load data
    data_file = "eu_vs_disinfo.csv"
    if not os.path.exists(data_file):
        logger.error(f"Data file {data_file} not found.")
        return
    df = load_dataset(data_file)
    logger.info("Dataset loaded successfully.")

    # Preprocess and predict
    texts = df['content'].apply(preprocess_text).tolist()
    languages = df['content'].apply(detect_language).tolist()
    labels = df['label'].tolist()
    predictions = predict_propaganda(texts)

    # Evaluate
    evaluate_model(labels, predictions)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Expected Output:

This project provides a comprehensive approach to detecting propaganda in multilingual news articles, leveraging state-of-the-art NLP techniques and models.
